q: Which HTML5 input attribute displays a short hint inside a field that disappears when the user starts typing?
exp: placeholder shows greyed hint text inside an empty input.

q: Two vertically adjacent block siblings have margin-bottom: 30px on the first and margin-top: 20px on the second. What is the gap between them due to margin collapsing?
exp: Adjoining vertical margins collapse to the larger of the two, i.e. 30px.

What is the output?
console.log(0.1 + 0.2 === 0.3);
exp: Floating-point representation makes 0.1 + 0.2 equal 0.30000000000000004, so the comparison is false.

q: Which HTTP response header instructs the browser to store a cookie?
exp: The server sends Set-Cookie; the browser returns it later in the Cookie request header.

q: Mosaic, the first widely popular graphical web browser, was developed at:
exp: Mosaic (1993) was created at the National Center for Supercomputing Applications by Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina.

q: Which DOM method adds a new node as the last child of a parent node?
exp: appendChild() appends a node to the end of the parent's child list.

q: Which statement about XML is correct?
options: Tags are predefined by the W3C
Attribute values need not be quoted
exp: XML is case-sensitive: <Name> and <name> are different elements.

q: In a RESTful API, which request is the most appropriate way to delete the user with id 5?
exp: REST maps the delete operation to the DELETE method on the resource URI.

q: Which service translates a domain name such as www.example.com into an IP address?
exp: The Domain Name System resolves host names to IP addresses.

q: What markers does <ol type="i"> produce?
exp: type="i" gives lowercase Roman numerals.

q: How many of seven <li> elements in a list are matched by the selector li:nth-child(odd)?
exp: Positions 1, 3, 5 and 7 are odd, so 4 elements are selected.

q: A server returns HTTP status 401 when:
options: the request lacks valid authentication credentials
the HTTP method is not allowed
exp: 401 Unauthorized means authentication is required or has failed.

q: In an XMLHttpRequest, readyState 4 together with status 200 means:
options: The request has been sent but nothing received
The request completed successfully and the response is ready
Only the headers have been received
exp: readyState 4 = DONE and status 200 = OK, so the response can be used.

q: Which of the following is regarded as the first search engine, created in 1990 to index FTP archives?
exp: Archie (1990) indexed file listings on anonymous FTP servers.

q: In the URL http://example.com/page.html#section2, the part "section2" is called the:
exp: The part after '#' is the fragment, which points to a location inside the page.

q: A group of radio buttons that share the same name attribute allows the user to select:
options: only one option in the group
exp: Radio buttons with the same name are mutually exclusive.

q: Which of the following is NOT a web server software?
exp: MySQL is a database management system, not a web server.

q:
Assertion (A): An element with display: none is removed from the page layout.
Reason (R): An element with visibility: hidden is also removed from the layout.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
exp: display: none removes the element from layout, but visibility: hidden keeps the space it occupies.

q:
What is the output?
console.log([1,2,3].map(x => x * 2).join("-"));
exp: map doubles each element giving [2,4,6]; join with "-" gives 2-4-6.

q: Which event is fired when the mouse pointer moves onto an element?
exp: onmouseover fires when the pointer enters an element.

q: In a flex container with flex-direction: row, the property justify-content aligns the items along the:
exp: justify-content works on the main axis, which is horizontal for row direction.

q: Which statement about SOAP is correct?
options: It works only with HTTP GET
It is lightweight and uses no envelope
It uses an XML envelope containing an optional header and a body
It cannot be carried over HTTP
exp: A SOAP message is an XML Envelope with an optional Header and a mandatory Body.

q: The robots.txt file on a website is used to:
options: tell crawlers which parts of the site they may or may not crawl
exp: robots.txt gives crawling instructions to well-behaved web robots.

q: Which HTML5 attribute prefix allows custom data to be stored on any element?
exp: data-* attributes (e.g. data-id) hold custom data accessible through the dataset property.

q:
What is the output?
console.log("5" == 5, "5" === 5);
exp: == coerces types so it is true; === also compares types so it is false.

q: Which HTTP version made persistent connections the default behaviour?
exp: HTTP/1.1 keeps connections open by default (keep-alive).

q: JavaScript was developed at Netscape in 1995 by:
exp: Brendan Eich created JavaScript at Netscape.

q: An HTML table has 3 rows. The first row contains a single cell with colspan="3"; each of the other two rows contains 3 cells. How many <td> elements are in the table?
exp: 1 + 3 + 3 = 7 td elements.

q: A div has box-sizing: border-box; width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 5px. What is its total rendered width?
exp: With border-box the declared width already includes padding and border, so the total is 300px.

q: Which attribute declares a namespace in an XML document?
exp: xmlns (XML namespace) associates element names with a namespace URI.

q: In a three-tier web application architecture, the web browser belongs to the:
exp: The browser displays the user interface, which is the presentation tier.

q: In the domain www.mail.example.co.in, the top-level domain is:
exp: The top-level domain is the last label, here .in.

q: Which attribute makes a hyperlink open the target page in a new browser tab?
exp: target="_blank" opens the link in a new window or tab.

q: Which CSS pseudo-class styles a link that the user has already visited?
exp: :visited matches links that exist in the browser history.

exp: HEAD returns only the response headers.
